description: A deep-relaxation body scan to settle body and mind before sleep or meditation. This is relaxation practice — it does not guarantee astral projection or any particular state.
name: Astral-Projection Relaxation Prep

phases.instruction: Lie down or sit comfortably. Close your eyes and let your breathing slow on its own.
phases.label: Settle in

phases.instruction: Bring attention to your feet and legs. Notice any tension and let it soften.
phases.label: Scan: feet and legs

phases.instruction: Move attention to your torso. Feel your belly rise and fall with each breath.
phases.label: Scan: torso

phases.instruction: Notice your hands and arms. Let them grow heavy and still.
phases.label: Scan: hands and arms

phases.instruction: Soften your shoulders and neck. Drop any held tension.
phases.label: Scan: shoulders and neck

phases.instruction: Relax your jaw, tongue, eyes, and forehead. Let the face be completely still.
phases.label: Scan: face

phases.instruction: Rest attention on the whole body at once. Simply notice what is there.
phases.label: Whole body

phases.instruction: Gently return. This was deep relaxation — no state is promised or required.
phases.label: Closing
